# Springhole.net

> A creative writing and critical thinking resource offering writing guides, worldbuilding tools, character generators, and debunking of pseudoscience and conspiracy theories.

Springhole.net combines practical creative writing instruction with skeptical analysis of fringe beliefs and pseudoscience. The site hosts a live community chat via Snoonet IRC and provides numerous generator tools alongside comprehensive guides for fiction writers.

## Key Topics

- character development
- worldbuilding
- magic systems
- fantasy writing
- original characters (OCs)
- creative writing advice
- writing craft
- conspiracy theories
- critical thinking
- satanic panic
- New Age spirituality
- false memories
- occult history
- canon characters
- fanfiction

## Creative Writing Guides

- [Tips For Writing Fanfiction With An OC Protagonist](https://springhole.net/writing/oc-protagonist-fanfiction.htm): Writing guide for fanfiction with original character protagonists
- [Tips To Create Better OC Relatives of Canon Characters](https://springhole.net/writing/write-oc-relative.htm): Guide to writing original character relatives of canon characters
- [On Worldbuilding A Magical Setting](https://springhole.net/writing/worldbuilding-a-magical-setting.htm): Guide to worldbuilding magical settings with folklore inspiration
- [On Keeping Magic From "Taking Over" Your Story](https://springhole.net/writing/keeping-magic-from-taking-over.htm): Tips for controlling magic systems in storytelling
- [The Trouble With Imitation In Fiction](https://springhole.net/writing/the-trouble-with-imitation.htm): Guide on avoiding thoughtless imitation in fiction writing
- [Basic Tips To Make Scarier & Better Creepypasta & Horror Creeps](https://springhole.net/writing/better-creepypasta-and-horror-characters.htm): Writing guide for creating scarier creepypasta and horror characters
- [What You Need To Know As An Anxious Creator](https://springhole.net/writing/you-need-to-know.htm): Advice for anxious creators dealing with imposter syndrome

## Writing Reference & Research

- [A Few Things Writers Should Know About The Occult](https://springhole.net/writing/a-few-things-writers-should-know-about-the-occult.htm): Writer's reference guide on occult history and misconceptions
- [Common Problems In Christmas Stories](https://springhole.net/writing/problems-in-christmas-stories.htm): Critical analysis of problematic tropes in Christmas stories

## Creative Writing Tools

- [Character Regret Generator](https://springhole.net/writing_roleplaying_randomators/character-regrets.htm): Random generator tool for character regrets in creative writing
- [Dramatic Curse Generator](https://springhole.net/writing_roleplaying_randomators/dramatic-curses.htm): Random generator tool for dramatic curses in fantasy writing

## Critical Analysis & Debunking

- [What's The Deal With Atlantis? (And Why It Definitely Never Existed)](https://springhole.net/other/the-deal-with-atlantis.htm): Debunking Atlantis myth and pseudoscience claims
- [What's The Deal With Michelle Remembers? The Book That Started A Witch Hunt](https://springhole.net/other/the-deal-with-michelle-remembers.htm): Analysis of satanic panic and false memory claims in Michelle Remembers
- [What Conspiracy Theorists & Bad "Psychics" Have In Common](https://springhole.net/other/conspiracy-theorists-vs-bad-psychics.htm): Analysis of cognitive biases in conspiracy theories and divination
- [So What's The Problem With Starseeds?](https://springhole.net/other/the-problem-with-starseeds.htm): Critical examination of starseed beliefs and New Age ideology
- [Relax, That's Not The Mark of the Beast!](https://springhole.net/other/not-the-mark-of-the-beast.htm): Debunking mark of the beast conspiracy theories and fears
- [Why New Age Spirituality Even Is Creepier Than You Thought](https://springhole.net/other/new-age-creepy.htm): Critical analysis of New Age spirituality and manipulation tactics

## Community & Personal Essays

- [Springhole.net Live Chat](https://springhole.net/chat.htm): Live chat community hub via Snoonet IRC network for creative help
- [The Story Of A Former Conservative Conspiracy Believer](https://springhole.net/other/story-of-a-former-conservative-conspiracy-believer.htm): Personal testimony on deconversion from conspiracy beliefs
